newsitem.title: CANADA: Schneider workers ratify pact at hog plant.
newsitem.headline: Schneider workers ratify pact at hog plant.

text.p: Union employees at Schneider Corp's hog slaughter plant in Winnipeg Monday night ratified a three-year contract by 93 percent, a United Food and Commercial Workers' Local 832 spokesman said.
The new contract expires June 30, 1999 and covers 230 union workers, UFCW spokesman Don Keith said.
The number of unionized employees was expected to double by the time Schneiders opens its new Winnipeg plant.
Construction on the C$40-million facility began June 11 and the transition to the new plant should begin in the spring, the company said previously.
Current UFCW members will each receive a C$800 lump sum payment and additional payments of C$500 in July of each of the two remaining years of the agreement, Keith said.
The company has told the UFCW that the base rate at the new plant will be no less than C$15 an hour, Keith added.
